$AAPL It hasn't closed above 161.8% in a weekly closing.  Will it be different this week.  One day to find out.  $317 is in play here if that double top is real.

$QCOM The pigs’ excuse today is Point #2—but we already knew Apple was working to replace Qualcomm chips. 
So what is actually new news? 
Point #1. Qualcomm secured an important win with $AAPL: the renewed patent license protects Qualcomm’s licensing relationship and royalty revenue even as Apple moves toward its own modem technology. 
Point #2. Apple reducing its reliance on Qualcomm modems is old news. The market already knew this. 
So here we go again: 
New positive news = ignored. 
Old news = recycled as an excuse to sell. 
Looks like the algorithmic whores got their excuse to run $QCOM into the red today. 
QTL wins the license. QCT deals with the modem transition.  
 
The pigs don’t need new news. They just need an excuse. 🐷
